title: LBDG Disclosure Maturity — Track schema
description: One file per track (e.g. government.json). Source of truth for both the public site (tiles + expandable rung cards) and the DVI v5 whitepaper. The narrative .md file remains the human-readable / whitepaper long-form; this JSON is the structured data the site renders.

scope.description: One line: what this track covers.

excludes.description: What it deliberately does NOT cover (domain purity).

scopeNote.description: Optional, e.g. 'International in scope, unlike US-only tracks.'

insight.description: Optional special call-out for the tile/header (e.g. Financial zero-Partial, International non-linearity). Omit if none.

summary.description: Card-ready 2-3 sentence summary; used at foot of fiche + meta.

sourcingQuality.description: Honest one-line on overall evidence level.

oneLiner.description: Shown when the card is collapsed (mirrors the PNG card's description line).

firstPrinciples.description: Why this rung exists / why it sits here.

sources.description: The featured evidence. Empty array allowed only when a 'none' tier entry represents an absence.

label.description: Display text, e.g. 'ODNI Preliminary Assessment, June 2021'.

tier.description: Drives the confidence badge. 'none' = no qualifying source (absence).

note.description: Optional, e.g. 'verbatim text not directly accessed', 'tangential precedent'.

flags.description: Short honest badges the UI can show, e.g. 'preprint', 'secondary-source', 'non-ontological', 'to-source', 'structural-ceiling'.

skepticChallenge.description: INTERNAL / whitepaper only — NOT rendered on the public site by default. Kept for rigor, not exposed so the page isn't framed around detractors.

arguable.description: Optional: genuinely arguable-status note (both sides). Deep level only.

excludedClaims.description: Collapsed annex: things deliberately excluded and why. Proves rigor without giving skeptics the frame. A source may be linked when the item is an officially-recorded document/testimony (see 'congressional record rule' in README): the link evidences the filing, not the truth of the content.

url.description: Optional. Link to the officially-recorded source (e.g. congress.gov hearing record). Presence of a link attests the document was filed, never that its contents are corroborated.

tier.description: Optional. Use 'official-proceeding' for documents entered into a congressional/parliamentary record.

bibliography.description: Optional: for tracks with a formal source list (Military, Scientific).

crossTrackNotes.description: Optional: domain-boundary notes (e.g. Loeb -> Scientific vs Government).

verificationAudit.description: Optional: collapsed audit summary (domain purity, independence test, etc.).
